thread:
maria: Heads up — after we flipped the regional-prefactor smoothing in prod at 03:12 we started seeing a surge of traffic for tier=gold bouncing to eu-west from us-east. Latency + tail p50/p95 spiked for affected customers. :eyes:

ajay: I see it in the routing logs — a lot of requests are being routed off-region and then falling back to the quantized v2 variant. Cost and latency both went up.

devon: Sample from the decision log (sanitized):
```
2026-03-20T03:12:35Z request_id=rr-7a2 route_decision=route-out region=eu-west reason=prefactor_bias delta=0.38 tier=gold fallback_variant=v2-quant
2026-03-20T03:12:35Z request_id=rr-7a2 downstream_latency=182ms status=200
```
Multiple requests show `delta` > 0.25 and we don't have a circuit to stop oscillation.

sara: That sounds like the smoothing weights are overshooting for small windows. We added an adaptive step last week — possible rounding bug when tier=gold is evaluated (gold uses different prefactor baseline).

leo: Repro locally by replaying live samples with the new smoothing param set. I can reproduce the prefactor > 1.0 drifting in <30s which forces the routing decision off-region.

maria: Okay mitigation plan needed now. @ops-bot please open incident and page SRE. Also let's prepare a console hot-toggle to pin region for impacted tiers.

ops-bot: incident-3438 created (cross-region-prefactor-spill). Pager duty notified: @sre-oncall.

ajay: Immediate hotpatch I propose: gate routing by prefactor delta and fail-closed to the local region when delta > 0.25. I'll send a small PR to the router service and coordinate a canary.

devon: Also add a temporary per-customer route override in the console UI so support can pin affected customers to us-east until we fix smoothing. UI toggle => `route_override.region=us-east` (scoped to tenant).

sara: Telemetry note: the `route_reason` tag vanished in the last deploy, so our dashboards don't show why the routes changed. That's making triage slow — we should re-enable that stream or add a fallback_reason field.

leo: Quick config rollback to cut the blast radius:
```
# patch smoothing off
kubectl patch config routing-config -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/smoothing/enabled","value":false}]'
```
I'll run that and then push an updated config with TTL=60s.

maria: Good. After Leo patches, Ajay can push the gate PR. Devon, can you prepare a short runbook for support with the console override steps? Sara, can you own the telemetry restore and a dashboard that surfaces `prefactor_delta` + `route_reason`?

sara: On it. I'll add a dedicated panel and re-enable the tag stream.

devon: Will write the runbook snippet and paste into #helpdesk once done.

ajay: PR posted: router#4512 — gate on delta + test harness. Can we canary to 5% of gold route traffic?

maria: Yes, canary to 5%. Ops to monitor latency + cross-region egress for 15m. If stable, promote.

ops-bot: Canary rollout initiated: router v1.13 -> 5% gold. Monitor channel: #eng-oncall.

leo: Patch applied to configstore. Confirming prefactor smoothing disabled. Seeing immediate drop in cross-region hits from our probe.

maria: Great. Postmortem action items: (1) add unit test for tier-specific prefactor math, (2) add circuit breaker for delta > 0.25, (3) surface `route_reason` in all routing dashboards, (4) console toggle for per-tenant region pinning. Assigning owners: Ajay(2), Sara(3), Devon(4), Leo(1).

sara: I'll sweep dashboards and open a telemetry PR.

leo: I'll add the math test and a guard to clamp prefactor to [0,1].

maria: Thanks team — keep updates here as we stabilize. :thumbsup:
